description: Real `codex debug prompt-input` output for the ready home after an install, plus 1500 personal skills from machine_support.crowd named aa-crowd-1 to aa-crowd-1500, which sort before the machine skill alpha-check: Codex drops entries in name order, alpha-check among them. Recorded from codex-cli 0.165.0-alpha.1.2, the CLI bundled in the ChatGPT app, on 2026-10-27, through machinelib.home.Home.run_codex with HOME set to a scratch home built as the suites build it. The scratch home's path is replaced by /fixture-home, the disposable CODEX_HOME by /fixture-home/.codex and the run's working directory by /fixture-cwd; everything else is verbatim.
